en: Colorized historic postcard view of a formal city square with a large ornate fountain in the foreground, featuring seated sculpted figures around a basin and a nude female statue on a tall pedestal at the center. The fountain is set within a landscaped garden with flowerbeds and paths, bordered by decorative metal fencing. Behind it are several grand late‑19th‑century style buildings with elaborate facades and trees lining the street. The caption at the top left reads 'Aussig a. Elbe.' and at the top right 'Monumentalbrunnen.' A handwritten red number is also present.
